value.rationale: Lemma 3 is presented as the local classification of the biologically relevant coexistence equilibrium and precedes the paper's bifurcation analysis. Its source predicate can overlap the saddle predicate even under the paper's own interior-existence hypotheses, so a reader applying the lemma can assign incompatible local dynamics to the same coexistence state. The exact witness and complete disjoint correction provide a reusable repair without disputing calculations that can be independently checked from their multipliers.
